claims.text: Arsenal have signed midfielder Bruno Guimaraes from Newcastle in a £75m deal.
Man City have agreed a deal to sign goalkeeper Rulli from Marseille, an FPL keeper option.
Liverpool are close to signing Barcelona defender Araujo on loan.
Cristian Romero is reportedly open to joining Arsenal but Spurs are resisting.

**What matters for FPL:**

- Arsenal have signed midfielder Bruno Guimaraes from Newcastle in a £75m deal. — [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c1719r079rjo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/videos/cp3r469vq79o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/aug/08/bruno-guimaraes-mikel-arteta-arsenal-options-midfield)
- Man City have agreed a deal to sign goalkeeper Rulli from Marseille, an FPL keeper option. — [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cwye10q7e92o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- Liverpool are close to signing Barcelona defender Araujo on loan. _(reported)_ — [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c4gxvvxldewo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
